meaning.zh:
“吓坏了” 或 “抓狂”。

这个短语起源于20世纪60年代的美国嬉皮士文化，意思是由于某种极端的情绪而失去冷静或控制。原初常用于描述吸毒者的反应，后来逐渐扩展到任何失去冷静、惊慌失措的情况下。
meaning.en: This phrase originated from the American hippie culture of the 1960s, meaning to lose composure or control due to some extreme emotion. Initially, it was used to describe the reaction of people under the influence of drugs, but it has since expanded to encompass any situation where someone is losing their cool or panicking.

lines.en: She started to *freak out* when she realized she had lost her wallet.
lines.zh: 当她发现自己丢了钱包时，她开始吓坏了。

lines.en: Don't *freak out*, we will figure this out together.
lines.zh: 别抓狂，我们会一起解决这个问题的。

lines.en: The kids *freaked out* when they saw the spider in the room.
lines.zh: 孩子们看到房间里的蜘蛛时吓坏了。
